title: My Faith Looks Up to Thee
description: My Faith Looks Up to Thee in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 4 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Ray Palmer, first published in 1830. The tune, OLIVET, is by Lowell Mason (1832). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: My faith looks up to Thee, Thou Lamb of Cal-va-ry, Sa-vior di-vine! Now hear me while I pray, take all my guilt a-way, O let me from this day be whol-ly Thine!

lines: My faith looks up to Thee,
Now hear me while I pray,
O let me from this day
As Thou hast died for me,
O may my love to Thee,
While life's dark maze I tread,

topics: Submission (see also Following Jesus, God - Providence of, Trust)
licence: Public domain. The Open Hymnal Project marks this hymn “copyright: public domain” (words, music and setting), and places its own editing, indexes and data files in the public domain.
